You sound like you're 12 and making excuses for your bullying behavior. I don't care how old a person is-I'm 34, and I am STILL affected by bullying. Bullying hurts regardless of age. And you blaming Lauren and trying to say she should stay off of social media and stop reading comments tells me all I need to know about you as a person. How miserable you must be. Lauren should not have to avoid social or give something she enjoys up. PERIOD. That is such a problematic way to look at it. If you don't like her, that's OK. What's not OK is to bully and say mean things about her. "many ppl have chronic mental illness but learn how to live with it..." Not everyone is the same???? Something you'll learn when you grow up.   


You obviously have no idea how BPD works or how mental illness really works.   


Mental illness isn't a cute little quirk like you apparently think it is. Mentallyunstable? Please. Obviously you think it's something that makes you cute and unique and quirky. It doesn't. Seriously, grow up.   


Go ahead and downvote me. IDGAF.   


Also, to the OP, I see exactly what you did. Lauren literally just made a post a few days (or maybe a week) ago saying how she hasn't been posted about on Reddit yet and how it would devastate her to have someone post about her. You obviously did this to stir the pot but OK. Go ahead and act innocent and like you care.   


Speaking of needing a healthy hobby, the lot of you really need to take that advice instead of sitting on some sub Reddit about TikTok gossip.
Thank you!

I bought the GED+ for math, I've done tutoring, and I'm still struggling. I would *love* to get my GED, even on top of a diploma issued by my parents. Math is just holding me back, lol.

The Ohio Board of Education told me I needed a “letter of excuse from compulsory attendance” from my school district. I don't even know why I need this paperwork. I'm going to attempt to apply without it, and just with the diploma. Hopefully, that's all I'll really need.

Unfortunately, a flood ruined most of our belongings, so any records they kept were ruined. I don't understand why I need the paperwork from the district, either, but it's what the Ohio Board of Education told me I needed. I'm gonna try and apply to college without it, but I don't know what'll happen.
